PlatformVersion.description: Version of PS.AppPlatform packages to reference

AppRole.description: Entra app role required to access this app

AppName.description: Lowercase Azure resource name id this app was provisioned with (matches appName in infra/app.bicep, e.g. 'scratchapp')

Frontend.description: Frontend starter to include: none, angular, or react

Tenancy.description: Tenancy model: none (authentication only), single (registered users and roles, one tenant) or multi (several tenants with tenant selection). single and multi need the management app.

ManagementUrl.description: Base URL of the management app (single/multi only)

ManagementAudience.description: api://<client id> audience of the management app's API (single/multi only)
